info.name: Palo Alto Networks SaaS Security API
info.description:
SaaS Security API (Aperture) for cloud application security. Provides programmatic access to security incidents, scanned assets, connected SaaS applications, user activity data, and log forwarding configuration. Enables security teams to automate incident response workflows, investigate exposed assets, and monitor user behavior across sanctioned SaaS applications including Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Box, Dropbox, and other connected applications.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support
